terms.grammar: phrase: lēns, lentis f., with the participle of adhaerēre
evidence: M-O s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens
terms.comment: Classically lēns is a lentil, whose shape gave the optical lens its name (Traupman 339: lēns optica); adhaerēns, clinging to the eye.

evidence: M-O s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens
terms.comment: Exemptilis, removable, is rare (Col., Dig., in Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: lens · Lewis & Short: adhaereo · Lewis & Short: exemptilis
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 339, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
